title: Minimum Reversals to Balance Brackets
description:
You are given a string `s` consisting only of `'('` and `')'`.

In a single operation, you may flip any one character (`'('` becomes `')'`, or `')'` becomes `'('`). Return the minimum number of flips required to transform `s` into a valid balanced parentheses string, or return `-1` if it is impossible.
hints: An odd-length string can never be balanced, so immediately return -1.
Cancel all already-matched "()" pairs using a stack; the leftover string consists of c closing brackets followed by o opening brackets, requiring ceil(c / 2) + ceil(o / 2) flips.

examples.explanation: After cancelling matched pairs, "))((" remains; flipping one ')' and one '(' makes "()()" in 2 flips.
"((()" cancels to "((", which needs 1 flip to become "()".
Odd length 3 cannot be balanced, so return -1.
